data.name: Viochar
data.description: Viochar is a Danish biochar startup producing biochar via pyrolysis for carbon removal and soil amendment. In August 2025 it entered a strategic partnership with Finnish biochar producer PUHI to jointly develop production plants and biochar/CDR sales in Scandinavia.
